name: Shadow Fiend
description: A shadow fiend is a dark entity from one of the daemonic planes that is naturally drawn to places of great evil or tragedy. While utterly evil, these fiends are not very aware of their surroundings and often wander aimlessly unless an unwitting humanoid gets too close.

actions.name: Dark Claw
actions.description: The shadow fiend swipes at a creature dealing physical and dark damage. If this attack targets a creature who is afraid, it deals an additional 2d4 dark damage.

actions.name: Siphon
actions.description: The shadow fiend latches on to a character and steals some of their life force, dealing true damage. For each damage that the shadow fiend deals, it gains 3 health. A creature that is afraid has a 1d4 penalty to their check against this ability.

actions.name: Stalk
actions.description: The shadow fiend moves up 2 units towards a creature that is afraid.

traits.name: Invisibility Field
traits.description: The Shadow Fiend is invisible unless a humanoid is within 2 units of it that does not have the afraid condition.

traits.name: Unstable Form
traits.description: The shadow fiend is not fully on the material plane. Physical damage that comes from a non-silvered weapon is reduced by half before applying mitigations against this creature.
